caption:
The video captures a clear crystal sphere resting on a band of wet, rounded pebbles at the edge of a calm lake during sunset. The sun sits low on the horizon to the right, casting a bright vertical glitter path across the water and onto the foreground stones. The sphere holds an inverted, refracted image of the same horizon and sky, with a warm sun-reflection streak glowing near its left side. A low dark shoreline and thin clouds in the orange-pink sky remain stationary throughout the segment.

While the sphere itself stays fixed in position and orientation, small waves and ripples continuously lap and recede over the pebbles around its base. The waterline and the wet sheen on the stones shift from frame to frame, so the reflected highlights keep changing shape. The sun's glitter path on the open water shimmers and breaks apart as the surface moves. Inside the sphere, the bright refracted streak flickers slightly in intensity with this external motion, yet its position within the glass remains essentially constant.
